svg.text: Bursts queue at the quota: in-flight requests stay within it, no 429s
3000 turns submitted at once; connection and provider both capped at 256 concurrent. A turn is 3 model calls (5 s ± 2 s) and 2 tool calls (1 s)
Apple M1 · 8 cores · 8 GB · one SQLite database · simulated model and tools
to finish all; theoretical floor 175.8 s
